verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a reviewer workflow: applicants can be manually approved/rejected in the dashboard (sumsub-docs-22), reviewers can inspect check results like Liveness in the applicant profile (sumsub-docs-13), and webhooks propagate status/decision changes back into the client's system (sumsub-docs-3, sumsub-docs-16, sumsub-docs-28), with verification levels defining the document/selfie/liveness checks that generate this evidence (sumsub-docs-5). However, the evidence pack never explicitly describes a dedicated 'manual review queue' for borderline cases, does not show extracted-field display alongside document images, and doesn't detail how reviewer decisions are recorded as an auditable feedback loop. Missing for 10: explicit borderline-queue/triage mechanism, extracted-field UI evidence, and documented reviewer-decision audit trail.
